20649-oomphel-in-the-sky.title: Oomphel In The Sky
20649-oomphel-in-the-sky.creator: H. Beam Piper
20649-oomphel-in-the-sky.description: A book by H. Beam Piper. He snapped on the communication screen in front of him, and Harry Walsh, the news editor, looked out of it at him from the office in Bluelake, halfway across the continent. He wanted to know how things were going.

arxiv-2203-13933.title: Quasinormal modes and stability of boosted Reissner-Nordström AdS black holes
arxiv-2203-13933.creator: Rodrigo D. B. Fontana, Filipe C. Mena
arxiv-2203-13933.description: Abstract We investigate the numerical stability of accelerated AdS black holes against linear scalar perturbations. In particular, we study the evolution of a probe non-minimally coupled scalar field on Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordström AdS black holes with small accelerations by computing the quasinormal modes of the perturbation spectrum.

arxiv-2211-11659.title: Formal Abstractions for Packet Scheduling CCS: Theory of computation Semantics and reasoning CCS: Networks Network properties DOI: 10.1145/3622845 oopslab23main-p376-p Journal: PACMPL Volume: 7 OOPSLA2 269 10
arxiv-2211-11659.creator: Anshuman Mohan, Yunhe Liu, Nate Foster, Tobias Kappé, Dexter Kozen
arxiv-2211-11659.description: Abstract . Early programming models for software-defined networking (SDN) focused on basic features for controlling network-wide forwarding paths, but more recent work has considered richer features, such as packet scheduling and queueing, that affect performance. In particular, PIFO trees , proposed by Sivaraman et al., offer a flexible and efficient primitive for programmable packet scheduling.

arxiv-2303-16148.title: Modelling Determinants of Cryptocurrency Prices: A Bayesian Network Approach
arxiv-2303-16148.creator: Rasoul Amirzadeh, Asef Nazari, Dhananjay Thiruvady, Mong Shan Ee
arxiv-2303-16148.description: Abstract The growth of market capitalisation and the number of altcoins (cryptocurrencies other than Bitcoin) provide investment opportunities and complicate the prediction of their price movements. A significant challenge in this volatile and relatively immature market is the problem of predicting cryptocurrency prices which needs to identify the factors influencing these prices.

arxiv-2309-00431.title: Proof of the Einstein quadrupole formula for solutions of the Einstein-Vlasov system close to Minkowski spacetime
arxiv-2309-00431.creator: Érik Amorim
arxiv-2309-00431.description: Abstract We rigorously derive the quadrupole formula within the context of the Einstein-Vlasov system. The main contribution of this work is an estimate of the remainder terms, derived from well-defined assumptions, with explicitly stated error terms that depend on the solution’s boundedness and decay properties, and the distance to the source.

arxiv-2312-05555.title: Axion limits from the 10-year gamma-ray emission 1ES 1215+303 Preprint: ITP-23-254, BNU-23-138
arxiv-2312-05555.creator: Hai-Jun Li, Wei Chao, Yu-Feng Zhou
arxiv-2312-05555.description: Abstract We present the limits on photon to axionlike particle (ALP) coupling from the 10-year period observations of the TeV BL Lacertae blazar 1ES 1215+303 (with redshift z = 0.130 z=0.130 ). The contemporaneous gamma-ray spectra are measured by the collaborations Fermi-LAT and VERITAS with five flux phases from 2008 to 2017, including four low states and one flare.

arxiv-2405-11823.title: Stereo-Knowledge Distillation from dp MV to Dual Pixels for Light Field Video Reconstruction
arxiv-2405-11823.creator: Aryan Garg, Raghav Mallampali, Akshat Joshi, Shrisudhan Govindarajan, Kaushik Mitra
arxiv-2405-11823.description: Abstract Dual pixels contain disparity cues arising from the defocus blur. This disparity information is useful for many vision tasks ranging from autonomous driving to 3D creative realism. However, directly estimating disparity from dual pixels is less accurate. This work hypothesizes that distilling high-precision dark stereo knowledge, implicitly or explicitly, to efficient dual-pixel student networks enables faithful reconstructions.

arxiv-2408-10003.title: Towards a Knowledge Graph for Models and Algorithms in Applied Mathematics
arxiv-2408-10003.creator: Björn Schembera, Frank Wübbeling, Hendrik Kleikamp, Burkhard Schmidt, Aurela Shehu, Marco Reidelbach, Christine Biedinger, Jochen Fiedler, Thomas Koprucki, Dorothea Iglezakis, Dominik Göddeke
arxiv-2408-10003.description: Abstract Mathematical models and algorithms are an essential part of mathematical research data, as they are epistemically grounding numerical data. In order to represent models and algorithms as well as their relationship semantically to make this research data FAIR, two previously distinct ontologies were merged and extended, becoming a living knowledge graph.

arxiv-2411-11341.title: Zhigang Bao
arxiv-2411-11341.description: Abstract Ultra high order cumulants and quantitative CLT for polynomials in Random Matrices Abstract: From the study of the high order freeness of random matrices, it is known that the order r cumulant of the trace of a polynomial of N -dimensional GUE/GOE is of order N^{2-r} if r is fixed.

arxiv-2503-00949.title: On general versions of the Petty projection inequality Thanks: The author is supported by the grant PID2021-124157NB-I00, funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033/“ERDF A way of making Europe”, as well as by the grant “Proyecto financiado por la CARM a través de la convocatoria de Ayudas a proyectos
arxiv-2503-00949.creator: Francisco Marín Sola
arxiv-2503-00949.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Francisco Marín Sola. The classical Petty projection inequality is an affine isoperimetric inequality which constitutes a cornerstone in the affine geometry of convex bodies. By extending the polar projection body to an inter-dimensional operator, Petty’s inequality was generalized in [ 18 ] to the so-called ( L p , Q ) (L_{p},Q) setting, where Q Q is an m m -dimensional compact convex set.

arxiv-2504-13120.title: Probing and Inducing Combinational Creativity in Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2504-13120.creator: Yongqian Peng, Yuxi Ma, Mengmeng Wang, Yuxuan Wang, Yizhou Wang, Chi Zhang, Yixin Zhu, Zilong Zheng
arxiv-2504-13120.description: Abstract The ability to combine existing concepts into novel ideas stands as a fundamental hallmark of human intelligence. Recent advances in vlm like GPT-4V and DALLE-3 have sparked debate about whether their outputs reflect combinational creativity—defined by M.A. Boden (1998) as synthesizing novel ideas through combining existing concepts—or sophisticated pattern matching of training data.

arxiv-2505-17132.title: Dynamic Token Reweighting for Robust Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2505-17132.creator: Tanqiu Jiang, Jiacheng Liang, Rongyi Zhu, Jiawei Zhou, Fenglong Ma, Ting Wang
arxiv-2505-17132.description: Abstract Large vision-language models (VLMs) are highly vulnerable to multimodal jailbreak attacks that exploit visual-textual interactions to bypass safety guardrails. In this paper, we present Dtr , a novel inference-time defense that mitigates multimodal jailbreak attacks through optimizing the model’s key-value (KV) caches.

arxiv-2506-07141.title: Highly efficient linear energy stable methods for preserving the original energy dissipation law of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equation
arxiv-2506-07141.creator: Zihan Weng, Qi Hong, Yuezheng Gong \comma \corrauth
arxiv-2506-07141.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zihan Weng, Qi Hong, Yuezheng Gong \comma \corrauth. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive computational framework to construct highly efficient linear energy stable methods for the incompressible Navier-Stokes equation, which preserve the original energy dissipation law. By multiplying the convection term by an identity-one term and incorporating a zero stabilization term, we recast the original model as a strongly equivalent system, while ensuring the retention of the original energy dissipation law.

arxiv-2602-11228.title: Rotation catalyzed chiral magnetovortical instability
arxiv-2602-11228.creator: Shuai Wang, Xu-Guang Huang
arxiv-2602-11228.description: Abstract We demonstrate that a background rotation significantly catalyzes the chiral magnetovortical instability in chiral magnetohydrodynamics. The rotation splits the linearly polarized Alfvén wave into two circularly polarized magneto-Coriolis waves, one of which exhibits a lower frequency than the original Alfvén wave.

pmc-11712900.title: Positive Tau and Amyloid Burden as Potential Predictors for Financial Capacity in Pre‐ Dementia Stages of Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-11712900.creator: Kayla Le, Andrei Bieger, Thomas Hugentobler Schlickmann, Sarah Wehle Gehres, Marco Antônio de Bastiani, Wyllians Vendramini Borelli, Eduardo R Zimmer, ADNI
pmc-11712900.description: BackgroundAmyloid and tau pathologies are the hallmarks of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Previous research indicated notable connections between financial capacity and AD biomarkers. Here, we aimed to understand whether financial capacity is affected by the cerebral accumulation of tau and amyloid. We hypothesized that amyloid and tau positivity will lead to a lower FCI‐Score.

pmc-12458773.title: Active vitamin D acts in vitro as an adjuvant to anti-TNFα treatment in a psoriatic synovial fibroblast activation model by modulating human Th17 activity
pmc-12458773.creator: Yi He, Bennie Van Heeswijk, Adriana M C Mus, Nadine Davelaar, Radjesh Bisoendial, Erik Lubberts
pmc-12458773.description: ObjectivesPsoriatic arthritis (PsA) is an IL-23/IL-17/TNF-driven inflammatory arthritis, commonly accompanied by vitamin D deficiency. Here, we investigate the interaction between PsA synovial fibroblasts (SFs) and human memory CCR6+Th17 (hmemCCR6+Th17) cells and evaluate the therapeutic effects of TNFα and/or IL-17A inhibitors, and the adjunctive therapy potential of 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 (1,25(OH)2D3).

pmc-12637938.title: Joint angle trajectories are Robust to segment length estimation methods in human reaching
pmc-12637938.creator: Rachel I. Taitano, Valeriya Gritsenko, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan, Jyotindra Narayan
pmc-12637938.description: BackgroundQuantitative movement analysis is increasingly used to assess motor deficits, but joint angle calculations depend on assumptions about limb segment lengths. These lengths are often estimated from average anthropometric proportions rather than measured directly. The extent to which such assumptions influence joint angle accuracy and variability remains unclear.

pmc-13081482.title: Clinical and epidemiological characteristics of hospitalized children with enterovirus infection: a retrospective study from 2016 to 2025 at Beijing children’s hospital
pmc-13081482.creator: Fei Li, Yong Sun, Luci Huang, Ruiting Yang, Jianing Yao, Yue Cui, Qiuping Li, Xiangpeng Chen, Zhengde Xie
pmc-13081482.description: BackgroundEnteroviruses (EVs) are important pathogens that cause neurological and systemic infections in children. Currently, only hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is monitored in China, indicating a lack of systematic surveillance for other EV-related diseases. Additionally, long-term epidemiological data on pediatric EV infections in Beijing are scarce.

pmc-13346583.title: Dual Impact: Coup–Contrecoup Brain Injury in a Young Cyclist—A Case Report
pmc-13346583.creator: Abhishek Kumar, Shashikant Prasad, Majid Anwer, Anurag Kumar, Anil Kumar
pmc-13346583.description: IntroductionCoup–contrecoup brain injury occurs when trauma produces focal damage both at the site of impact (coup) and at the contralateral side (contrecoup) due to intracranial pressure (ICP) dynamics and rotational forces. These injuries are frequently seen in high‐velocity accidents and often demand staged neurosurgical intervention.

pmc-13407268.title: Acid-modified biochar combined with reduced nitrogen fertilizer improves soil organic carbon and cotton yield in saline-alkali soil
pmc-13407268.creator: Shining Liu, Yongjie Wei, Xiaofeng Wang, Jing Yang, Jiao Lin, Wenqing Zhao, Wei Hu, Mingwei Du, Zhiguo Zhou, Sumei Wan
pmc-13407268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSaline-alkali soils commonly face the dual challenges of low stock and activity in soil organic carbon (SOC), and long-term excessive nitrogen (N) fertilizer application further exacerbates soil quality degradation. pmc-13444074.title: FrogPCSP: a propeptide cleavage site predictor for frog antimicrobial peptides
pmc-13444074.creator: Esdras Matheus Gomes da Silva, Taran Grant
pmc-13444074.description: Frogs produce and secrete cutaneous antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), which serve as chemical defense against microbial infections and have great biotechnological potential. AMPs are stored in intracellular vesicles in skin glands as propeptides. Before secretion, proprotein convertases (PCs) cleave propeptides into acidic spacer peptides and bioactive peptides.

pmc-13453904.title: Usefulness of Prognostic Stage in High-Risk Early Luminal Breast Cancer
pmc-13453904.creator: Mio Adachi, Toshiyuki Ishiba, Takashi Kuwayama, Tomoyuki Aruga
pmc-13453904.description: Introduction:Breast cancer remains the most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide, with prognostic outcomes and therapeutic responses differing considerably across subtypes. The conventional staging framework developed by the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC), based on the Tumor, Node, Metastasis classification, reflects anatomical stage (AS) but overlooks biological characteristics.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9067.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9067 — Assistant Surgeon General for Dental Services
uslaw-usc-t10-s9067.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9067.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization); Chapter 907 (The Air Force). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There is an Assistant Surgeon General for Dental Services in the Air Force who is appointed by the Secretary of the Air Force upon the recommendation of the Surgeon General from officers of the Air Force above the grade of lieutenant colonel.

uslaw-usc-t15-s9202.title: 15 U.S.C. § 9202 — NSF support of research on manipulated or synthesized content and information security
uslaw-usc-t15-s9202.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s9202.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 117 (Identifying Outputs Of Generative Adversarial Networks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. uslaw-usc-t16-s831cc.title: 16 U.S.C. § 831cc — Separability
uslaw-usc-t16-s831cc.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s831cc.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 12A (Tennessee Valley Authority). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The sections of this chapter are declared to be separable, and in the event any one or more sections of this chapter be held to be unconstitutional, the same shall not affect the validity of other sections of this chapter.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
